player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''adrock''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.
description: A Big Blue Dark deck that utilizizes Tractor Beams to dominate the Light Side in space.

notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (5): Fondor, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order, Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60. No objective (the author explains why); Fondor is the starting location.
The header lines 'DARK SIDE - IMPERIAL HOSPITALITY' and 'a.k.a. "Overall Tractor, Overall Beam"' are the deck name, not cards.
Oppressive Enforcement and Secret Plans were Effects in 2001 (Special Edition), not Defensive Shields.
Posted 'Endor', 'Kashyyyk', 'Kessel' and 'Sullust' dested the Dark system pages (Endor: Endor set; Kashyyyk: A New Hope; Kessel: Premiere; Sullust: Death Star II).

Posted 'Death Star II Docking Bay' / 'Executor Docking Bay' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay / Executor: Docking Bay; 'U-3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Bossk In Hounds Tooth' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'I Can't Shake Him' dested I Can't Shake Him!.
The post says the deck was played at the 2001 Vegas DPC and lost once (by seven); it also says Ira Babb took the deck to the Texas State Championship and placed 5th.
player_note: The post says this is the deck he took to the 2001 Vegas DPC, where it lost only once; no final placing is given. The post was updated after the event but does not say the list changed.
